A better default

Prediction is a record, not a headline.

Each forecast is a durable object with a timestamp, a data cutoff, an uncertainty range, and a future outcome.

01

Make the evidence visible

Market data, cited research, model version, and the decision horizon remain attached to the prediction.

02

Respect the arrow of time

Models are evaluated through chronological walk-forward testing, with leakage controls around every fold.

03

Measure the result later

When the horizon matures, the original forecast is scored against the realised outcome instead of being rewritten.
